TCS has been a great pioneer in feeding the fire of young Techies like you. We are a global leader in the technology arena and there’s nothing that can stop us from growing together.

  • Experience in developing REST APIs and Microservices
  • Strong understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns

payload.title: Walkin Drive ID for GM India

payload.qualifications:
Eligibility Criteria :
1.BE/B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MS with minimum 3 years of relevant experience post Qualification IT- Experience.
2.Bsc Graduates with minimum 4+ years of relevant experience post qualification IT Experience.
3.Only Full Time courses would be considered.
4.Consistent academic records Class X onwards (Minimum 50%)

1.TCS Online Application Form
2.Resume
3.One Photograph (Passport Size)
4.Original and Copy of Government Photo ID Proof (PAN Card/Driving License/Passport)
5.Last 3 months pay-slip

12.PG Mark-Sheets & Degree Certificates

To help us expedite the process, kindly register at our Careers Portal, create a profile and provide us with your registration number and a copy of your completed application form along with the other documents at the time of interview.
